java-fundamentals.question: What is the default value of an int variable in Java?
java-fundamentals.explanation: Primitive int variables are initialized to 0 by default in Java.

java-fundamentals.question: Which keyword is used to prevent inheritance in Java?
java-fundamentals.explanation: The 'final' keyword prevents a class from being inherited.
Post-increment (x++) returns the original value, then increments. So 5 is printed.

java-fundamentals.question: Which collection allows duplicate elements?
java-fundamentals.explanation: List interface allows duplicates. Set implementations do not.

java-fundamentals.question: What is the time complexity of ArrayList.get(index)?
java-fundamentals.explanation: ArrayList uses an array internally, so random access is O(1).

dsa-basics.question: What is the time complexity of binary search?
dsa-basics.explanation: Binary search halves the search space each iteration, giving O(log n).

dsa-basics.question: Which data structure uses LIFO principle?
What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort?
dsa-basics.explanation: QuickSort degrades to O(n²) when the pivot selection is poor (already sorted array).

dsa-basics.question: In a Binary Search Tree, which traversal gives sorted order?
dsa-basics.explanation: Inorder traversal of a BST visits nodes in ascending order.

dsa-basics.question: What is the space complexity of recursive DFS on a graph?
dsa-basics.explanation: DFS uses O(V) space for the recursion stack in the worst case (linear graph).
